title: Final Velocity Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive and present the correct formula for the transformed velocity v'.

title: Final Angle Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive and present the correct formula for the transformed angle tan(ϕ').

title: Limit Check
description: Important Criteria: The student should verify that the derived formulas yield the correct limit as v approaches c.

title: Use of Lorentz Factor
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Lorentz factor gamma in the velocity transformations.

title: Direction Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that the direction of motion is consistent with the transformations applied.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid unit mistakes, ensuring all velocities are in consistent units.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be cautious of sign mistakes in the velocity transformation equations.
